description: Source code for a C++ program that converts PHP files to JST format by processing PHP code snippets, replacing PHP syntax with JavaScript-compatible syntax, and handling file I/O and directory traversal.

classes.name: PhpProcessor
classes.description: Abstract base class for processing PHP code snippets, providing methods for handling tags, characters, and error reporting.

classes.name: EchoProcessor
classes.description: Processes PHP echo statements to convert them into JavaScript function calls.

classes.name: ConcatProcessor
classes.description: Handles string concatenation in PHP, converting '.' to '+' for JavaScript.

classes.name: PhpNameProcessor
classes.description: Replaces PHP-specific file extensions and tags with JST equivalents.

classes.name: ArrayProcessor
classes.description: Converts PHP array syntax to JavaScript array or object syntax.

classes.name: Number2StringProcessor
classes.description: Converts numeric array elements to string representations using toString().

classes.name: ForEachProcessor
classes.description: Transforms PHP foreach loops into JavaScript for-in loops.

methods.name: getFilesInDirectory
methods.description: Recursively retrieves files matching a pattern from a directory.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into memory.

methods.name: processCode
methods.description: Processes PHP code snippets, applying transformations via a PhpProcessor subclass.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads a PHP file, applies multiple code transformations, and writes the output as a .jst file.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; parses arguments, searches for files, and processes each file.
